test_title: PYST 47: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 03 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As per the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways of the Government of India, which port is known as the largest container port in India (as of May 2025)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nhava Sheva**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Nhava Sheva, also known as Jawaharlal Nehru Port (JNP),** is the largest container port in India as of May 2025.
 
• Located in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, Nhava Sheva handles a significant portion of India’s container cargo, contributing immensely to international trade.
 
• The port has state-of-the-art infrastructure and automation systems, making it the most efficient container terminal in India.
 
• Nhava Sheva operates **five container terminals**, including those managed by DP World and APM Terminals, ensuring seamless handling of cargo.
 
• It accounts for **over 50% of India’s containerized cargo volume**, making it a critical hub for imports and exports.
 
• The port is well-connected via rail and road networks to major industrial and commercial centers across India, boosting its logistical capabilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chennai Port:**

 
 
• One of the oldest and most significant ports in India, located in Tamil Nadu.
 
• Primarily serves southern India and handles diverse cargo types, including automobiles, petroleum products, and containers.
 
 
 
• **Kandla Port:**
 
 
• Situated in Gujarat, Kandla Port is one of India’s major ports focused on bulk cargo handling, especially petroleum, chemicals, and grains.
 
• It plays a pivotal role in trade with the Middle East .
 
 
 
• **Paradip Port:**
 
 
• Located in Odisha, Paradip Port is a major port for handling bulk cargo such as coal and iron ore.
 
• It is strategically significant for industries in eastern India but does not compete with Nhava Sheva in container cargo handling.
